summary: iter-350 regression on the 3 Implant Survival Review refinements (global bottom End Implant Treatment button + modal, PlacementDatePicker matching Phase-1 calendar UX, multi-round revision chain rendering in Implant Planning). Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass — end_treatment still validates decision_maker+reason, replacement still enforces placement_date (400 without / 200 with), and R0->R1->R2 chain build-up works (posted 2 replacements on 699fc5c2 and confirmed repl.revision_number=2, repl.chain length=1 with the intermediate 'Straumann BLX' Failed entry). Frontend verified: (a) bottom 'End Implant Treatment' button (data-testid=survival-end-treatment-btn) is BELOW both 'Update & go back' (y=221) and 'Continue to Phase 3' (y=205) at y=268, centered on the viewport (center X=700 for a 1400 wide screen), with solid red bg (rgb(198,40,40)) and white text; (b) Tapping it opens the confirmation modal that renders all 4 required test IDs — end-treatment-reason (default 'Peri-implantitis'), end-treatment-decision (Patient/Operator options), end-treatment-reason-text textarea, and end-treatment-confirm (red bg rgb(198,40,40)). PlacementDatePicker + chain-render + case-detail termination banner end-to-end UI could NOT be exercised in Playwright due to the KNOWN iter-299 deep-link 403 issue (token hydration on direct route) — code review confirms all iter-350 refactor requirements are met (see critical_code_review_comments). Direct backend REST calls confirmed the underlying data is correct (chain persisted, R2 Nobel Active as active-implants entry, R1 Straumann BLX in archived).

integration_issues.flow: Deep-link navigation to /procedures/{id} and /procedures/survival-review/{id} for AUTOMATED tests
integration_issues.issue: First navigation after login sometimes hits 403 on the initial /procedures/{id} and /procedures/{id}/active-implants calls because the axios auth token has not yet been hydrated from AsyncStorage. Same issue was reported in iter-298 and iter-299 (already listed as OPTIONAL/LOW). Users clicking through the app UI never see it because the token is already in memory by the time they navigate — but Playwright deep-link tests do. This blocks in-browser QA of the calendar picker + chain-render tiles for iter-350.

action_items: OPTIONAL (carried forward from iter-298/299): add a global axios interceptor that awaits token hydration before firing the first /procedures/{id} request. Would unblock deep-link automated QA for calendar picker + chain rendering + termination banner.

OPTIONAL: seed a case with position 24 (upper right first molar) that has R0->R1->R2 so the exact 'Site #24 · 3 revisions' string mentioned in the review request is visible; the current chain seeded on 699fc5c2 uses tooth 16 (same shape, different position).
critical_code_review_comments: PlacementDatePicker.tsx: correctly built on react-native-calendars; renders a TouchableOpacity trigger with calendar icon + human-readable date label + chevron; Modal opens on tap with react-native-calendars grid; invalid=true applies red border (triggerInvalid). Placeholder 'Tap to select placement date' is passed from survival-review, so trigger shows it before any date is picked — matches Phase-1 UX. onDayPress sets date + closes modal — good UX.
survival-review/[id].tsx L611-618: PlacementDatePicker wired with maxDate=today, invalid={!f.replacement.placement_date}, testID=imp-{i}-repl-date. Legacy TextInput date fallback has been removed.

survival-review/[id].tsx L715-732: bottom End Implant Treatment global button is styled with solid red (s.endTreatmentGlobalBtn), white text, chevron/close-circle icon, centered via endTreatmentGlobalWrap alignItems:'center'; a red-tinted helper caption 'Terminates the entire case.' clarifies scope.

survival-review/[id].tsx L736-801: End Treatment Modal captures failure_reason (Dropdown, default 'Peri-implantitis'), decision_maker (Dropdown Patient/Operator), and end_reason (multiline TextInput). Confirm button uses same red style with 'Confirm & End Treatment' label + spinner while submitting.
server.py L4370-4374: replacement path still enforces placement_date; validation returns HTTP 400 with the string 'Replacement requires a placement date' — matches the FE canSubmit gate.

server.py L4375-4420: R0->R1->R2 chain build-up is correct — when a new replacement lands on an implant that ALREADY has a replacement, the prior replacement is moved into repl.chain[] with status='Failed' + failure_reason + failure_date; revision_number auto-increments. Confirmed via backend pytest that repl2.chain length=1 and chain[0].status='Failed' after 2 replacements.

server.py L4341-4349: end_treatment validation still enforces decision_maker + reason. Confirmed via backend pytest (test_end_treatment_missing_decision_maker + test_end_treatment_missing_reason both return 400 with the right detail).

CaseImplantPlanning.tsx L734-753: group header only renders when siteRevisionCount > 1 (i.e., hidden for a plain R0 that never failed). R0 chip on the plan tile is also gated by showRevisionChips — meets the 'sites without any revisions must NOT show group header and R0 chip' spec.
CaseImplantPlanning.tsx L921-974: chain items (R1..Rn-1) render as inactive tiles with 'Historical record — read-only' badge, R{n} chip, 'Inactive' status chip — matches spec.
CaseImplantPlanning.tsx L976-1005: current active replacement renders with R{n} chip, green 'Active' status chip, testID=implant-revision-active-{idx} — matches spec.
Positional check verified in-browser: End Treatment button center X = 700 on a 1400-wide viewport (perfectly centered); y=268 sits below Update (y=221) and Continue (y=205) buttons.
